title: Analytics dashboard engagement - closeout
description: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Freelance developer Lena Fischer has finished building a web analytics dashboard for Brightleaf Studio and hands ongoing responsibility to the client's in-house lead. All names, systems and references are fictional.

items.title: Dashboard v1.0 with five agreed reports
items.detail: Delivered and signed off by the client.

items.title: Data import job for the web shop
Mobile layout fixes for the revenue report
items.detail: Two layout issues remain on small screens; not part of the signed-off scope.

items.title: Monitoring the nightly import job
items.detail: Check the job log each morning; rerun manually on failure.

items.title: Post-delivery support by the freelancer
items.detail: Bug fixes for delivered scope until 2026-11-30, by email, two working days response. New features are out of scope.

items.title: Export limited to 10,000 rows per report
items.detail: Known limitation of the charting component; larger exports must be split by date range.

items.title: Import fails when the shop API changes its schema
items.detail: The job stops and logs an error; mapping must be updated manually.

items.title: Source repository and deployment notes
items.detail: Repository 'brightleaf-dashboard', README covers local setup and deployment.

items.title: Operations guide
items.detail: Daily checks, rerun procedure, backup location.

items.title: Nightly batch import instead of real-time sync
items.detail: Chosen to stay within the shop API rate limits.

items.title: No customer-level data stored in the dashboard
Hosting account - admin role
items.detail: Transfer of the admin role is requested through the hosting provider's ownership-transfer form.

items.title: Who renews the charting component license in March?
items.detail: The license is currently registered to the freelancer.

not_applicable.deadlines: No dated commitments remain after delivery; support ends with the contract.
